_comment: Head-part layer: core words that map to a whole optics group and would otherwise be `ambiguous`. When such a word is matched and `raw` carries no qualifier, the matcher returns `default`; when `raw` carries a qualifier keyword, it resolves to that qualifier's part_id. Editable by hand — add entries / words / qualifiers freely. `words` are normalized on load (lowercased, AZ-aware); qualifier keywords are matched as substrings against the tokens of the raw+phrase text; the first matching qualifier wins, else `default`.
